description: Source code for the xnc_connection_manager class, managing XNC connections, message handling, and CU-CP integration in a telecommunications context.

classes.name: shared_xnc_connection_context
classes.description: Holds shared context for an XNC connection, including connection state and message handling.

classes.name: xnc_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Thread-safe notifier for forwarding XNAP messages from the gateway to CU-CP.

methods.name: connect_xnc
methods.description: Associates an XNC repository index with the context and links to the XNAP handler.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the message handler is attached, indicating an active connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the XNC repository and marks the connection as disconnected.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Processes incoming XNAP messages, forwarding them if connected.

methods.name: xnc_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
methods.description: Handles forwarding of messages and manages lifecycle for CU-CP communication.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Dispatches received messages to the CU-CP executor, with retries on failure.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes connection management, scheduling setup routines.

methods.name: connect_to_neighbours
methods.description: Initiates connection requests to neighboring XNAPs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops connection management, disconnecting from neighbors.

methods.name: handle_new_xnc_cu_cp_connection
methods.description: Handles new incoming CU-CP connections, associating them with XNAPs and managing context.
